newsitem.title: USA: Ingram Micro names Jerry Stead chairman ahead of IPO.
newsitem.headline: Ingram Micro names Jerry Stead chairman ahead of IPO.

text.p: Ingram Micro Inc., the world's largest distributor of microcomputer products, Tuesday named Jerre Stead chairman and chief executive, effective immediately.
Stead is the former chairman and chief executive officer of Legent Corp. before its acquisition by Computer Associates International Inc. and of AT&T Corp.'s Global Information Solutions (NCR Corp.).
Stead replaces Lindwood Lacy, who left in May.

The company said its plans for an upcoming initial public offering are unchanged. It is awaiting favourable ruling from the Internal Revenue Service on a tax-free split-off from its parent company, Ingram Industries Inc.
Once the IRS ruling is received, plans will be finalised on the exact timing of the IPO, it said.
Ingram Micro, based in Santa Ana, Calif., is a wholesale distributor of microcomputer products, including the software of industry leader Microsoft Corp. It had sales of $8.6 billion in 1995.
